name: Peter Zhang
shortBio: Founder of ProudTek. Writes and reviews ProudTek's RFID/NFC buyer guides and comparison pieces.
bio: Peter Zhang is the founder and editor-in-chief of ProudTek. He has spent 18 years in RFID/NFC manufacturing, and personally operates ProudTek's in-house RFID laboratory in Shenzhen. Day-to-day he supervises tunnel-washer wash-cycle qualification of industrial-laundry tags, signs off every addition to the hotel-lock compatibility matrix published on proudtek.com, and reviews the company's NFC-card and UHF-RAIN articles before publication. Peter's four focus areas are custom NFC business-card manufacturing, hotel-lock RFID compatibility (MIFARE / DESFire), RFID laundry-tag selection for hospitality, and UHF RAIN (EPC Gen2v2 / ISO 18000-63) deployments. Articles Peter signs that cite a technical standard are co-signed by a named reviewer on the /about/review-board/ page; his own byline is backed by factory operating experience rather than a published academic or standards-body record.
expertise: UHF RAIN RFID (EPC Gen2v2 / ISO 18000-63) deployments
